mini: Look out a window until your eyes relax.
Stand up and let your shoulders drop.
Rest your eyes on something far away.
Drink a glass of water.
Unclench your jaw and take one slow breath.
Roll your wrists and let your hands hang loose.
Look left, then right, without turning your head.
Put both feet on the floor and sit up straight.
Blink slowly a few times.
Look at the ceiling and let your neck lengthen.
Stretch your arms overhead for a moment.
Stand and take three slow steps.
Let your shoulders fall away from your ears.
Gaze at the farthest thing you can see.
Relax your grip and open your hands.
Take one long breath out.
Sit back until your back meets the chair.
Look away from the screen for ten seconds.
Turn your head to one side, then the other.
Drop your chin and feel the back of your neck.
Walk to the nearest window.
Rest your palms on your thighs and breathe.
Shrug your shoulders, then let them go.
Look at something green if you can find it.
Take your hands off the keyboard.
Say the next sentence in your head before typing it.
Stretch one arm across your chest, then the other.
Sit up and imagine a string lifting your head.
Close your eyes for five slow breaths.
Roll your ankles under the desk.
Look at a corner of the room and soften your eyes.
Take a sip of something warm.
Stand up and stretch toward the ceiling.
Let your knees fall apart a little.
Blink and look at something twenty paces away.
Loosen your feet inside your shoes.
Take one breath that fills your ribs.
Turn your palms up and let your fingers curl.
Look at the wall and let one thought finish.
Stand, settle your weight, and sit down again.
Look up from the screen and blink slowly.
Set both feet flat and press them into the floor.
Let your hands rest open on the desk.
Turn your chair away from the screen for a moment.
Look at the tree outside, if there is one.
Take a sip of water and set the glass down.
Straighten your back and let your chest open.
Rest your eyes on the wall behind the screen.
Move your mouse hand away from the mouse.
Uncross your legs and let your knees fall open.
Take one breath that reaches your lower ribs.
Look at something blue for a few seconds.
Let your jaw hang loose for one breath.
Stand up and feel the floor under both feet.
Turn your palms up and let your fingers uncurl.
Look out the window until the next car passes.
Drop your shoulders and let your arms hang.
Blink ten times, slowly.
Listen to the room for one full breath.
Rest your forehead in your hands for a moment.

long.title: Step away
long.text: Walk to a window and look at something far away.

long.title: Move a little
long.text: Take a short walk, even if it is just down the hall.

long.title: Leave the screen
long.text: Put your phone down and let your eyes rest.

long.title: Reset your posture
long.text: Stand up, roll your shoulders back, and breathe out slowly.

long.title: Get some air
long.text: Open a window or step outside for a minute.

long.title: Drink something
long.text: Fill a glass and drink it away from your desk.

long.title: Stretch your back
long.text: Reach for the ceiling, then fold forward gently.

long.title: Let your eyes rest
long.text: Cover them with your palms and breathe.

long.title: Walk it off
long.text: Take ten slow steps and let your thoughts settle.

long.title: Warm your hands
long.text: Rub your palms together until they feel warm.

long.title: Look far away
long.text: Find the most distant thing you can and hold it.

long.title: Loosen your neck
long.text: Tip your ear to one shoulder, then the other.

long.title: Move your shoulders
long.text: Circle them slowly, forward and back.

long.title: Sit differently
long.text: Move to another chair or stand for a while.

long.title: Check your feet
long.text: Plant both feet and feel the floor.

long.title: Breathe deeper
long.text: Take five breaths that reach your belly.

long.title: Unwind your wrists
long.text: Rotate them slowly in both directions.

long.title: Rest your voice
long.text: Stop talking for the whole break.

long.title: Take a short walk
long.text: Head to the kitchen and back.

long.title: Look at the sky
long.text: Find a window and watch it for a moment.

long.title: Straighten up
long.text: Sit tall and let your shoulders fall.

long.title: Let your jaw go
long.text: Part your teeth and breathe through your nose.

long.title: Water your eyes
long.text: Look at something green for a minute.

long.title: Stop early
long.text: Finish the break before the timer, if you are ready.

long.title: Look up
long.text: Find the highest thing you can see and rest your eyes on it.

long.title: Open a window
long.text: Let fresh air in and stand beside it for a minute.

long.title: Take the long way
long.text: Walk to the far side of the room and back.

long.title: Rest your wrists
long.text: Let your hands hang by your sides and shake them out.

long.title: Clear the desk
long.text: Move one thing you no longer need out of sight.

long.title: Look outside
long.text: Watch the sky for a minute without checking the time.

long.title: Stand tall
long.text: Reach up, then let your arms fall slowly.

long.title: Give your eyes a break
long.text: Close them and cover them with your palms.

long.title: Step outside
long.text: Stand at the door and take five slow breaths.

long.title: Move your neck
long.text: Look over one shoulder, then the other, without hurrying.

long.title: Set the next hour
long.text: Write down the one thing you will do next.

long.title: Put the screen to sleep
long.text: Lock it and leave it for a minute.
